movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couples dance based on European figure dances

music_profile.sound_description: A blend of European melodic figures from the contredanse with the rhythmic drive of the banboula and kalenda.

teaching.level_notes: The dance requires knowledge of figure-based patterns similar to the quadrille.
